title: Samsung bolsters M&A team as it eyes robotics, AI
html:
Samsung Electronics is strengthening its mergers and acquisitions (M&A) operations as it seeks growth in robotics, artificial intelligence (AI), and data center cooling to offset weakness in its consumer electronics businesses.
